notes.title: Update Early Access 0.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773479/f77b348403120b7b89286393540a8ed65cc70671.png

hello. everyone! How have you been?
Our White Trick has completed its second update.

 As we prepare for updates, we are paying close attention to the reviews and messages you send us. The supportive support and sometimes harsh reprimands become the driving force that allows us to grow. Thank you as always for your love for our games.
We will do our best to make the game more fun to play.


The new map you've been waiting for so long has been released in mac OS version along with the expansion pack!
Now enjoy White Trick on mac OS!
Additionally, we would like to inform you about the updates to version 0.3.


● Added features

  Expansion pack has been released! 
   ⚬ WhiteTrick: Western
  Mac OS version has been released.
  Added chat system.


● Improvements

  The shortcut key guide has been improved so that it can be viewed in the options window.
  Improvements have been made to make it easier to know your character.
  Added sound when a user enters the lobby.
  Visual effects have been added to existing and new maps.
  We have improved it so that when you close the game by pressing the 'End Game' button in the in-game options, you can move to the main screen.
  Improvements have been made to prevent the mouse cursor from moving out of the screen when playing the game in windowed mode.
  Two skill animations have been added. (Helper, jumping over the fence)
  Improved to clearly see which user is currently on the turn.
     ⚬ Add an icon to the top of the character head
     ⚬ Addition of character profile UI
  Improved the overall UI in the game.
     ⚬ In-game turn bar UI/UX modifications
     ⚬ Edit point button color
     ⚬ Remaining time UI misaligned image correction
     ⚬ Modification of game creation pop-up UI
     ⚬ Added yellow guide line when selecting a skill card


● Fixed issues

  Fixed an issue where moving tiles would sometimes move away when using a skill on the entire map screen.
  Fixed an issue where although it was White’s turn, the character profile was displayed as Samuel’s turn.
  Fixed an issue where the turn end button was disabled even though it was your turn.
  Fixed an issue where in rounds 1 and 2, if a thief arrived at the trading location on turn 15, the game would end due to failure to commit an additional crime.
  Fixed an issue where the tile in the relevant part of the toast message could not be clicked when it was displayed.
  Fixed the issue of text overlapping when clicking the ‘Restore Defaults’ button while the Guide tab in Options is open.

notes.title: Early Access 0.2 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773479/9b2298230af42d59dba678605e12aa67dd453281.png

Hello everyone!
White Trick has finally released its first update since its early access release!

 Thank you very much for playing the game and leaving a message and review. Even though we may not be able to reply to everyone, we are checking each and every one of them without missing anything and will strive to improve. Thank you again!

We will inform you about updates.

● Added features

    Two languages ​​added. (Japanese, Spanish)
    When creating a new game, a function has been added to set the number of participants.
    The number of characters that can be selected has been set according to the waiting room number option.
    Added banishment function from waiting room.
    Added the ability to continue following the character in progress by pressing the space bar in-game.


● Improvements 

    The method of participating by pressing the ‘JOIN’ button on the public room list has been improved.
    The structure of the waiting room has been improved.
    When selecting a character in the waiting room, a presentation has been added to the selected character.
    We have improved the ping system so that you can use it even when playing from the top view in-game.
    The READY button and readiness UI have been improved after selecting a skill in-game.
    Improved the issue of overlapping toast messages in-game.
    The overall map design in-game has been improved.
    Added in-game direction and animation.
     ⚬ Add particle and button animation when mouse clicks
     ⚬ Added running character animation at the top of the loading gauge bar
     ⚬ Add end turn button animation
     ⚬ Added gradient effect to timer on turn end button
     ⚬ Added 10 types of action animations (investigation success/failure, arrest failure, running animation, skill use, multiple IDLE)
     ⚬ Added 4 types of skill animations (bicycle, jaywalking, police car, call)
